commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
LA="$HOME/local-agent"
CTRL="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/litegraph/control"
echo '=== local-agent checkout ==='
git -C "$LA" branch --show-current
git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD
git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all
git -C "$LA" rev-parse origin/main || true
echo '=== supervisor ==='
ps -ww -p 71830 -o pid=,ppid=,etime=,command= || true
echo '=== fetched control request ==='
git -C "$CTRL" fetch --quiet origin agent-control || true
git -C "$CTRL" show origin/agent-control:.agent/daemon/control.json || true
echo '=== ack visibility ==='
git -C "$CTRL" ls-tree --name-only origin/agent-control -- .agent/daemon/acks/chatgpt-local-agent-v4131-self-update-20260902-2154.json || true
echo '=== launchd/log tail ==='
launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.michal.local-agent 2>/dev/null | tail -n 40 || true
tail -n 120 "$HOME/Library/Logs/local-agent.log" 2>/dev/null || true
tail -n 120 "$HOME/Library/Logs/local-agent-error.log" 2>/dev/null || true
